To calculate the 2-year Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) from FY2020 to FY2022:

$$\text{CAGR} = \left( \frac{\text{Ending Value}}{\text{Beginning Value}} \right)^{\frac{1}{n}} - 1$$

$$\text{CAGR} = \left( \frac{65,984}{65,398} \right)^{\frac{1}{2}} - 1$$

$$\text{CAGR} = (1.00896)^\frac{1}{2} - 1 = 1.00447 - 1 = 0.00447$$

Expressed as a percentage and rounded to one decimal place, Lockheed Martin's 2-year total revenue CAGR is **0.4%**.
